methods.label: Location of the altitude intersection
methods.explanation: The lines containing the three altitudes of a triangle intersect at one point. For an acute triangle, this point is inside the triangle; for a right triangle, it is at the right-angle vertex; and for an obtuse triangle, it is outside the triangle.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing the intersection location of altitude lines is within Grade 8 triangle geometry.
